items.title: 68239_Ram Ramirez oral history interview
items.q: I studied a bit with Kincaid, harmony

ctx.x: in those years, you know. Then we played "Chinatown". We used to buy them from the guy that... There were covers... And the big bands were selling them to the other bands. That was the big thing in those days. Then I had made a few. As soon as I learned to read... Boy, I read a book by Frank Scranton(?), and I began to orchestrate immediately! I'll never forget when I (?) read.

So along in the pursuit of studying, I studied a bit with Kincaid, harmony... Then I had a... Who else? I had a teacher who... Gee, I forget the guy's name. Then of course, I had... At Commerce High School, we... I was in the band in the school; my instrument was a bassoon, believe it or not. It was a symphony orchestra. I didn't do too well there; I can tell you that. Because they ran out of instruments! And piano wasn't required there at the time; you know, glockenspiel. I didn't... Actually, I played also some…
